response: "When FBI operative Rachel Jenkins is sent back in time to 1962, she finds herself in the midst of a decades-old serial killer case. The notorious 'Time Traveler's Terror' has been leaving a trail of bodies across the country, and Rachel's unique knowledge of future forensic techniques is the only hope for catching the killer. With the help of a local detective, Jack Harris, Rachel must use her skills to leave clues that will lead her modern colleagues to the killer's next victim. But as the body count rises, Rachel realizes that the killer is not only a master of evasion, but also a time-traveling genius. Can Rachel and Jack unravel the threads of time to prevent the killer's next move, or will the Time Traveler's Terror strike again, leaving a trail of death and destruction in his wake? 1.
